      <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3798">pa ra hi ta</rs>

            <l>brgyud de <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4128">sa bzangs pa</rs> la gnang ba'o ||</l> </lg>
